prompt: Create an original 60 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; D major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective instrumental piece featuring a string ensemble and classical guitar, evoking a classical or folk-like atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而沉思的器乐作品，由弦乐合奏和古典吉他演奏，营造出古典或民间音乐的氛围。
